QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Speaking Hall Preparation 4 (Stew)
QuestInfo.0: Stew, the Democratic donkey, needs your help.
QuestInfo.1: Stew needs t-shirts to advertise their cause, and the Barnard Grays seem to be fond of wearing them. Bring Blank T-Shirts so he can do some printing and get them back to the Grays.
QuestInfo.2: You got 50 t-shirts! Return to Stew.

0.0: Those aliens are crazy for t-shirts, but they never have anything on them. I-I see an opportunity. I bet those Republicans are already planning on using them as walking advertisements. Not if we get 'em first! That's campaigning.

yes.0: You're going to be the star of the show!

no.0: I knew you were red on the inside!

1.0: I see a whole lot of shirts!

yes.0: This is a brand new day for political t-shirts. I'll start making them up as soon as the latest online polls tell me which one is best...

stop.0: These t-shirts are both environmentally friendly, AND hypoallergenic.
